senses.gloss:
Paṭharvan appears to be the name of a man in the Rigveda. According to Ludwig, however, the word is Paṭharu, and is the name of a fort which was saved by a rain-storm from being set on fire.
Foot notes i. 112, 17, with Sāyaṇa's note.
Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 204.
Cf. Griffith, Hymns of the Rigveda, 1, 147, 148.
